thread.title: The 6 Best Tech Deals for Black Friday 2018

title: The 6 Best Tech Deals for Black Friday 2018
text:
Roku Ultra Streaming Player $50 (50% off)
Cut the cord with Roku ’s (ROKU) popular top-of-the-line video-streaming player that works with all major third-party streaming services such as Netflix (NFLX) and Amazon.com (AMZN) Prime Video.
The Roku Ultra lets you stream in 4K has a neat feature, where you can plug in your headphones into the remote for private listening. Target will sell it for half off on Black Friday. —and also Google Pixel 3 $600 (25% off)
The flagship Google Pixel 3 just came out last month, but that doesn’t mean it won’t be on discounted for Black Friday. Best Buy (BBY) will sell the Pixel 3, which many say has the best camera of any smartphone, for $200 off with a Verizon line activation. iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max or iPhone XR ($300 gift card)
The best deal for Apple (AAPL) iPhone fans is at Walmart. Buyers can get a free $300 Walmart gift card if they buy an iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max or iPhone XR with a wireless plan from AT&T (T), Sprint (S) or Verizon Communications (VZ).
For those that need better Wi-Fi coverage inside their house to play the latest online games, access the Internet and stream video, the well-reviewed Netgear (NTGR) Nighhawk AC2600 is a great deal for half off at Walmart.
